Subject: Your land dispute matter - R.C.S. No. 2873/2022

Dear Mr. Mehra,

Thank you for meeting us on 30 June 2022 about your dispute with Ananya Goyal. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot. The matter is listed before the Kolhapur District Court.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 3,33,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
